security_audit.summary: All 24 static detections are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, declared service URLs, or configuration-path documentation. Semantic review found high-risk guidance to execute unpinned remote packages and a command supplied by the hosted service. These execution paths require remediation before publication.

remediation.suggestion: Pin exact CLI versions, publish checksums, and remove automatic confirmation before downloading and executing packages.
Replace data.next_command execution with structured fields mapped to fixed, allowlisted arguments and require explicit user approval.
Default to workspace-scoped installation and require review before changing global Codex or agent directories.

content.user_title: Generate Hosted AI Audio with Luxin
content.value_statement: Creating AI audio often requires separate providers, credentials, and billing. This skill guides hosted generation through Luxin with spending controls and durable results.
actual_capabilities: Guides text-to-audio generation with a hosted Stable Audio model.
Provides a no-spend guide before a media generation command.
Supports prompts for music, ambience, effects, and sound design.
Sets an estimated spending limit in the main runtime example.
Documents durable media links, recoverable jobs, receipts, and feedback.
Explains workspace-local Codex configuration when global targets are unavailable.
limitations: Requires internet access and the external Luxin service.
Generation may consume Luxin credits and requires explicit spending permission.
Does not provide a local audio model or direct provider integration.
Model availability, latency, policy support, and payment options may vary.

use_cases.title: Create Game Ambience
use_cases.description: Generate loop-ready environmental audio with a stated mood, setting, and texture.

use_cases.title: Draft Podcast Music
use_cases.description: Produce a short musical direction for intros, transitions, or closing segments.

use_cases.title: Prototype Sound Effects
use_cases.description: Explore prompt variations for interface sounds, impacts, movement, or atmospheric effects.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Sound
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration] audio clip of [sound], with [mood] and no vocals. Use the no-spend guide first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one clearly described audio result.

prompt_templates.title: Design Background Ambience
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate seamless ambience for [setting]. Include [elements], avoid [unwanted sounds], and keep the result suitable for looping.
prompt_templates.scenario: Background audio for a scene, game, or video.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a Music Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration] instrumental track using [instruments], [tempo], and [structure]. Set the spending limit to [amount] before generation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Controlled music exploration with creative and budget constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Advanced Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce three variations of [concept]. Change [dimension] across versions, preserve [fixed traits], and report each job, cost, and durable link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced comparison requiring traceable outputs and controlled variation.

output_examples.input: Create ten seconds of quiet rain on a metal roof with distant thunder.
output_examples.output: A recoverable hosted audio job with a durable media link and an estimated cost receipt.

output_examples.input: Generate a warm analog synth transition without vocals and keep spending below twenty cents.
output_examples.output: A hosted instrumental result that follows the prompt and records the configured spending limit.

output_examples.input: Explore three interface confirmation sounds with different brightness levels.
output_examples.output: Three traceable generation jobs with distinct prompt variations, durable links, and cost details.

best_practices: Run the no-spend guide before allowing media generation.
State duration, mood, sound sources, exclusions, and intended use.
Review every command, spending estimate, and destination before execution.
anti_patterns: Do not execute a hosted command without validating its arguments.
Do not use unpinned packages for unattended generation.
Do not send confidential prompts or audio to a hosted service.

faq.question: Does this skill run an audio model locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses Luxin's hosted runtime and requires network access.

faq.question: Do I need provider API keys?
faq.answer: The skill says provider credentials are unnecessary. Luxin may create and store an optional restricted token.

faq.question: Can generation cost money?
faq.answer: Yes. Run the no-spend guide first and approve media spending only after reviewing the estimate.

faq.question: What audio can I request?
faq.answer: The skill supports music, ambience, effects, sound design, and general text-to-audio prompts.

faq.question: Can I recover generated results later?
faq.answer: The skill describes recoverable jobs and durable hosted media links within Luxin.

faq.question: What should I do if Luxin lacks a required capability?
faq.answer: Use a fallback only for the missing capability, then submit feedback describing the gap and observed behavior.
